Memorial Day Weekend

May 22-25, 2026




Red River invites you, your loved ones, and friends to join us this Memorial Day weekend as we come together to honor and remember our fallen heroes. This special gathering is a time for reflection, gratitude, and unity as we celebrate the freedoms their sacrifice has preserved and the community that continues to thrive because of them.

Art & Wine Festival - Vino in the Valley

June 19-21, 2026




The annual Art & Wine Festival is presented by the Red River Chamber of Commerce every Father’s Day weekend in Brandenburg Park.

8750 BBQ & Music Festival

August 13-16, 2026




Red River’s 8750′ Festival returns with three days of great music alongside cookoff competitions for BBQ, red chili, and green chile.

5th Annual River Music Gathering

September 2026




Casey James, Amanda Kate Ferris and Michael Smith return for the River Music Gathering. This is a private event for our guests and friends only, so book your spot now! The playground will be closed during the performances. Bring your chairs!

Abel Mountain Campground is now closed for the season. We hope to see everyone again during the 2026 season. In the meantime, enjoy the holidays and winter! Check back soon, since we will be posting our 2026 events schedule as soon as dates are finalized.

Superheroes

04/17/2026 –04/19/2026

Not all superheroes wear capes, some wear badges. Join us for a hero-themed weekend filled with arts and crafts, a vibrant vendor fair, live entertainment, and special guest appearances.

Mother's Day Nature Appreciation

05/08/2026 –05/10/2026

Moms, treat yourself this weekend! Enjoy a vendor fair, mom-only activities, a special kids' craft session, and live entertainment on Saturday night.

Water Wars Memorial Day

05/22/2026 –05/25/2026

Kick off summer with us! Pools open this weekend. Bring your tie-dye gear for family crafts, enjoy vendors, a pool party, and an epic water war (don't forget your super soakers). Saturday night features live entertainment, with yard sales, a DJ, and Bingo wrapping up the weekend.

4th of July

07/03/2026 –07/05/2026

Decorate your campsite and your golf cart to celebrate our nation's birthday 250th birthday. Join us for a weekend of vendors, crafts (bring your items to tie-dye), games, live entertainment, and DJ pool party.

Holiday

07/24/2026 –07/26/2026

Happy holidays! We missed you this offseason, and we're ready to celebrate together. Join us for a festive weekend featuring a vendor fair, crafts, games, brunch with Santa, and a Saturday night grand finale with live entertainment.

Labor Day Blowout

09/04/2026 –09/07/2026

Close out summer with hands-on fun, local vendors, and tie-dye activities (so bring your items). Enjoy live music Saturday night and yard sales with DJ music on Sunday.

Tailgate

09/11/2026 –09/13/2026

Football is back! Wear your team gear and decorate your site and golf cart in team colors. Enjoy crafts and activities, plus the return of our Chili Cook-Off and potluck. Bring a side dish to share and join the chili judging.

Myths and Legends Weekend

10/02/2026 –10/04/2026

Halloween has arrived! Kick off our first Halloween weekend with Bloody Mary, the Hitchhiker, werewolves, and all things that go bump in the night. Experience a paranormal investigator, s'mores, vendors, a costume contest, golf cart decorating, trick-or-treating, and live entertainment. Don't forget to decorate your site!

Zombie Apocalypse

10/23/2026 –10/25/2026

Enter a post-apocalyptic world where survival skills meet spooky fun. Wrap up our final Halloween weekend with s'mores, vendors, a costume contest, golf cart decorating, trick-or-treating, and more. Don't forget to decorate your site.

Deer Hunting at Harriman State Park
A portion of Harriman State Park is open for deer hunting to address the loss of forest biodiversity and the lack of tree regeneration due to long-term over-browsing by deer. This year's deer hunting season is weekdays only, excluding holidays, following NYSDEC deer seasons and ends on December 31, 2025.

Beginning November 3, 2025, Harriman State Park will be opened for deer hunting to address the loss of forest biodiversity and the lack of tree regeneration due to long-term over-browsing by deer. This year's hunting season will run until December 31, 2025.

77th Memorial Day Good Turn at Jefferson Barracks
May 24, 2026 at Jefferson Barracks National Cemetary

Scouts of all ages are invited to participate in the 77th Annual Memorial Day Good Turn on Sunday May 24, 2026, hosted by Gravois Trail District. Registration will be from 10:30 am until 11:30 am at the VA Hospital Orange Lot with the procession into the cemetery beginning at 11:30 am. Upon check-in, the unit leader or designated adult will receive a map and participation ribbon. Patches will be available for $5.00.

For more than seven decades, approximately 5,000 Scouts have gathered at Jefferson Barracks National Cemetery before Memorial Day to decorate each of the approximately 280,000 graves with an American Flag. In its 77th year (2026), the tradition is one of the longest-running Memorial Day events within Scouting.

Opening Weekend

04/03/2026 –04/05/2026

Celebrate opening weekend with a festive Easter-themed day on Saturday! Start the morning with an Easter craft at 10 a.m., then stop by at noon for pictures with the Easter Bunny. The Easter egg hunt begins at 1 p.m., followed by a fun activity making your own Peep house at 3 p.m. On Sunday morning, join us for coffee and Danish in the Welcome Center at 9 a.m.

Welcome Back Weekend

04/10/2026 –04/12/2026

Kick off the camping season with a fun weekend of activities! Friday evening begins with Candy Bar Bingo at 6 p.m., followed by an adult dart competition at 9 p.m. On Saturday, get creative by making a spring snow globe at 11 a.m., then enjoy a nature hike at 1 p.m. The afternoon continues with a birdhouse craft at 3 p.m.

Prom Weekend

08/21/2026 –08/23/2026

Prom weekend brings plenty of creative fun before the big event. Friday begins with making a duct tape corsage at 6 p.m., followed by decorating the Rec Hall at 8 p.m. Saturday starts with a Kids Can Cook graduation celebration at 10 a.m., then kickball at noon and a game of Pass the Prize at 2 p.m. Crafts begin at 4 p.m. in the Rec Hall, and the prom takes place from 7-10 p.m.

Back to School Weekend

08/28/2026 –08/30/2026

Ease into the school season with a simple evening of fun. Join us Friday at 6 p.m. for Back-to-School Bingo, then stick around for an adult pool tournament at 9 p.m.

Friendsgiving Weekend

09/25/2026 –09/27/2026

Gather with friends and neighbors for a weekend of gratitude. Friday evening begins with Family Bingo at 7 p.m. On Saturday, create a Thanksgiving craft at 11 a.m., then join the community Thanksgiving meal at 5 p.m.

Let's Clean Up Weekend

10/16/2026 –10/18/2026

Help us get the campground ready for the end of the season. Join the Mays Landing Community Meeting at 2 p.m. on Saturday, and bring any non-expired, non-perishable food items to the Welcome Center for donation to the Community Church. Last year our campers donated 18 bags of food.

Special Event: Heritage Day 2026
Applications for 2026 Special Events opened on Wednesday, 9/3/2025.

The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Louisville District is transitioning management of Pikes Ridge Campground Recreation Area at Green River Lake for the 2026 recreation season. Effective March 1, 2026, Pikes Ridge Campground Recreation Area will be managed under a lease agreement with Common Capital RE Holdings LLC, with BrightSky Campgrounds overseeing day-to-day operations and reservation services on behalf of the lessee.
The Louisville District will continue working to ensure a smooth transition for visitors ahead of the 2026 recreation season.

The 2026 camping season has arrived! Enjoy Springtime in New England and camp with us on the weekends and store your camper on site during the weekdays. No more hassle towing back and forth for weekend getaways! Stay with us from the start of the season through the weekend prior to Memorial Day for $1,030.00 (30 amp site) / $1,090.00 (50 amp site) or stay for the Memorial Weekend festivities for $1,275.00 (30 amp site) / $1,350.00 (50 amp site) with electric utilities included!
Opening Day. Welcome to our 2026 season!

Join us down at the Main Office at 9:00 AM for Pumpkin Pick-Up! Purchase a locally grown pumpkin, carve it during the day at your campsite and return for our Annual Pumpkin Lighting & Viewing at 6:30 PM! Starting at 5:00 PM, Trick-Or-Treating begins! Participation signs can be picked up in the main office. Bring your ghoulish selves to the Pavilion at 7:00 PM to follow with our last Dance of the 2026 season!

The Rio Grande National Forest announced on April 23, 2025 they are seeking candidates such as commercial businesses, nonprofit organizations, community organizations, and educational institutions to provide recreational experiences for individuals or groups on the Conejos Peak and Saguache Ranger Districts. Successful candidates may receive a special use permit to conduct their activity on Rio Grande National Forest lands.

Fridays through April 10, 2026   2 p.m. - 5 p.m.
Music at the Mountain Karaoke Jam
Lost Dutchman State Park

Miss America is back to host a creative musical event at the park, featuring Y-O-U! Bring your talent (or plain enthusiasm is fine too!), voice or other instruments to this combination karaoke/ jam session!

LEARN MORE

Saturday, April 4, 2026   4 p.m.
Music in the Mountains Concert Series: Eric Schaffer and The Other Troublemakers
Catalina State Park

Enjoy an afternoon of country western and folk music with recording artists Eric Schaffer and The Other Troublemakers.

LEARN MORE

Saturday, April 4, 2026   2 p.m.
Blast from the Past: Coronado Cannon Firing
Tubac Presidio State Historic Park

Join us for an unforgettable event with internationally renowned archaeologist, Dr. Deni Seymour, and special guests. Highlights include the dramatic firing of a replica 1541 bronze cannon along with an up-close look at the original weapon and its pivotal role in the Coronado Expedition.

LEARN MORE

Saturday, April 11, 2026 (Monthly, April - November)   6 p.m. (Varies by month)
Star Party and Guest Speaker at Homolovi State Park
Homolovi State Park

Come out to Homolovi's Visitor Center Museum and Observatory for a night under the stars. Enjoy astronomy presentations featuring special guests with telescope viewing to follow. Bring your sense of wonder!

LEARN MORE

Sunday, April 12, 2026   1 p.m.
Geology Hike at Red Rock State Park
Red Rock State Park

Our monthly-guided geology hike led by our knowledgeable volunteers will take you out on our trails to discuss how Sedona transformed into what we see today. This interpretive experience is for both the beginner and experienced hiker. Reservations are required. This is an Outdors250 event.

April 12, 2026   3 p.m.
Riordan Mansion Special Tour: Prohibition
Riordan Mansion State Historic Park

A special guided tour of Riordan Mansion with a focus on Prohibition in Flagstaff and what was happening in the Riordan house. Space is limited; advanced ticket purchase is required.

Owl Walks at Catalina State Park
Catalina State Park

Camping is a fun activity to enjoy year-round for those who are prepared.

The winter camping season begins on October 20, 2025 and ends on May 18, 2026. During the winter camping season in Rocky Mountain National Park, Moraine Park Campground is the only campground open.

Campsites will be available in Loop A from sites 1-62, Loop B, Loop C, and Loop E on a first come, first served basis. Groups of 8 or more should use a group site in Loop E.

Electric sites are available in Loops B and C.
Moraine Park Campground will close at noon on Monday, May 18 for maintenance in preparation for the upcoming 2026 summer camping season.

for the 2026 season

Opening Weekend

05/01/2026 –05/03/2026

Welcome back for Opening Weekend as we gather at the gazebo to kick off the season. Spend some time reconnecting with fellow campers and settling in for another great year at the campground.

Mother's Day Weekend

05/08/2026 –05/10/2026

Celebrate Mom with a fun Mother's Day craft and something special just for her. It is a great way to spend time together and make the weekend extra meaningful.

Memorial Day Weekend

05/22/2026 –05/24/2026

Join us for Memorial Day Weekend and enjoy our annual vendor fair, beach fun, and music throughout the weekend. It is a great time to relax, explore, and kick off the season with family and friends.

Christmas in July

07/17/2026 –07/19/2026

Celebrate Christmas in July with festive site decorating, a visit from Santa, adult and kids bingo, and crafts for the kids. It is a fun way to bring a little holiday cheer to the middle of summer.

Candy Land

08/14/2026 –08/16/2026

Step into a life-size game of Candy Land and enjoy a sweet day of fun for kids and adults alike. The fun also includes adult-child bingo and kids' crafts for a playful event the whole family can enjoy.

Labor Day Weekend

08/28/2026 –08/30/2026

Celebrate Labor Day Weekend with a full lineup of activities for all ages. Enjoy dancing, cool off with snow cones, and take a relaxing hay ride. The fun continues with adult and child bingo, along with crafts for the kids throughout the weekend.

Camper Appreciation

09/04/2026 –09/06/2026

Join us for a weekend dedicated to our campers. Spend time together, enjoy the activities, and celebrate the community that makes the campground such a special place.

Halloween Weekend

09/11/2026 –09/13/2026

Wear your best costume and get ready for a weekend full of spooky fun. Enjoy trick-or-treating around the campground, take a ride on the haunted hayride, and get creative with pumpkin carving. The night wraps up with a spooky dance to end the day on a festive note.

Fall Festival

09/18/2026 –09/20/2026

Celebrate the season with a day of fall fun. Make your own scarecrow, enjoy hot cider, and gather around the bonfire for s'mores as the evening sets in.

Friendsgiving

09/25/2026 –09/27/2026

Celebrate Friendsgiving with a Sandy Beach twist as we come together for a Thanksgiving-style gathering at the campground. It is a warm and welcoming way to enjoy good company and the spirit of the season with fellow campers.

Mother's Day Weekend

05/08/2026 –05/10/2026

We love our moms, so let's show them how much we appreciate them. Friday night kicks off with bingo, followed by a special brunch in the Barn on Saturday - please sign up in the office to reserve your spot. During the day, create a keepsake for Mom at craft time, then enjoy a live performance by Counting Stars on Saturday night.

Memorial Day Weekend

05/22/2026 –05/24/2026

Join us as we honor our veterans, past and present, and thank them for their service. Enjoy a full weekend of activities including bingo, tie-dye your own SG T-shirt, the golf cart parade, and s'mores around the campfire. Saturday night features a live performance by the Famous Rumors Variety Band, followed by a craft show on Sunday. On Monday morning, take part in the area community Memorial Day Pilgrimage.

Christmas in July

07/24/2026 –07/26/2026

Get ready for a festive Christmas in July celebration as Santa makes his summer stop to check in on all the camping fun. Browse the craft show on Saturday to find the perfect gift, then decorate for the golf cart parade and join in the holiday spirit. In the evening, head to the lawn for a live performance by Counting Stars and sing along with friends and family.

Labor Day Weekend

09/04/2026 –09/06/2026

We work hard, so let's celebrate the fruits of our labor with a full weekend of fun. Pack up the camper and enjoy bingo, craft time, a wet hayride, a movie, singing, dancing, and more. Saturday night features a live performance by Mama's Horn, followed by a craft show on Sunday with Misfits on a Mission and karaoke Sunday night. Wrap up the weekend with one last hooray as summer comes to a close.

First Responders Weekend

09/11/2026 –09/13/2026

Thank you to our first responders. We appreciate all that you do and your dedication to keeping our communities safe. Firefighters, police officers, and first responders can show proper ID to receive 20% off their campsite for the weekend. Join us for a themed craft and a special ceremony of honor and remembrance, and enjoy live music in the evening.

Columbus Day and Haunted House 1 Weekend

10/09/2026 –10/11/2026

The SG Haunted House opens for the season with new frights every year. Survive bingo on Friday night, then enjoy a full day of fun on Saturday with a costume parade, trick-or-treating, craft time, and hayrides. Be sure to visit the craft vendor show supporting Misfits on a Mission, a local Cancer Relay Team.

Haunted House II Weekend

10/16/2026 –10/18/2026

Can you not get enough of the frights? Come back for a second weekend and bring your friends along. Enjoy a full lineup of Halloween fun with a costume parade, trick-or-treating, crafts, and hayrides, then enter the Haunted House if you dare. Catch a movie on the big screen, weather permitting, and see if you can make it through the weekend unscared.

Pumpkin Patch Weekend

10/23/2026 –10/25/2026

It is all about pumpkins this weekend. Pick your pumpkin from the SG patch and show off your carving skills. Join in the Halloween egg hunt and enjoy all your favorites, including hayrides, a costume parade, trick-or-treating, and your last chance to experience the Haunted House.

Elite Site Camping Only

10/30/2026 –11/01/2026

Upper-level camping only in the 1500s for this final weekend of the season. There are no scheduled events, so take this time to relax and enjoy some good camping fun. Celebrate another great season with fellow campers, and we look forward to seeing you next year.

Fete de Glace — Festival of Ice
January 26, 2025

This ice festival is the perfect family activity. Ice carvers fill two blocks of North Main Street in St. Charles. You can watch carvers bring the ephemeral art of ice carving to life with chainsaws, chisels, grinders and knives, as well as hot irons and cold spray. Each carver starts with a single block of ice weighing 260 pounds and dissects it and reassembles it into wondrous sparkling creations.

St. Louis Food and Wine
February 1, 2025

With hundreds of wine and craft beer to taste and culinary delights around every corner, this is the can’t-miss event of the year! Plus, it benefits the Repertory Theatre of St. Louis. Be a part of the largest international food and wine show in the Midwest – now in St. Louis Union Station!

Soulard Mardi Gras Parade
March 1, 2025

The Mardi Gras Parade is the crown jewel of the Soulard Mardi Gras season and is the biggest parade outside of the Big Easy. It begins at Busch Stadium and proceeds through the streets of Downtown South and Soulard to the place where your beer was born: Anheuser-Busch Brewery.

St. Patrick’s Day Parade
March 14, 2026

Regularly noted as one of the top in the country, the parade is comprised of over 120 units, including marching bands, floats, huge cartoon-character balloons, 5000+ marchers, and lots of clowns. Over 250,000 spectators regularly attend, the largest of any event in downtown St. Louis, packing the streets with smiling Irish eyes and festive green attire.

Augusta Plein Air Art Festival
April 24 - May 3, 2025

The rolling hills & woods of Augusta, Missouri will be dotted with springtime’s ‘splashes of color’, and one of Mother Nature’s most picturesque settings will again serve as the perfect scene for artists from across the country. Come and witness artists completing their pieces in the tradition of Plein Air (outdoors), capturing the nuances of natural light in their work.

May 13, 2025

St. Louis Cabaret Festival
June 1-7, 2025

Celebrate the annual St. Louis Cabaret Festival, a unique event that spans 6 nights filled with showcases and performances from talents across the country. Each night has its own theme performance with a big final showcase at the end of the week.

Celebrate Saint Louis
July 3, 4, 2025

Celebrate Saint Louis is a FREE admission event produced each year by St. Louisans for St. Louisans and their guests celebrating our nation’s independence each Fourth of July. The Fair typically hosts hundreds of thousands of attendees listening to fantastic music, playing in the Festival Zone, checking out new products in the Interactive Zone and of course, being “wowed” by the nationally recognized fireworks displays each evening – all for FREE.

Let them Eat Art
July 11, 2025

Don’t miss out on the annual Maplewood celebration Let Them Eat Art. The event celebrates local, eclectic creativity. You’re invited to bring the whole family (even your pet) and enjoy inspiring artwork, delicious food and cocktails from local vendors, live music, and an atmosphere full of joy, diversity and local pride.

Kirkwood Peach Festival
July 19, 2025

Fringe Festival
August 11-17, 2025

Immerse yourself into the eclectic performing arts scene that local STL artists have to offer. St Lou Fringe builds community by connecting uncensored, unjuried performing arts with accessible and affordable performances for audiences.

Festival of the Little Hills
August 15-17, 2025

The largest festival of the year, activities include over 300 craft booths, with some demonstrations by crafts people and artisans. Also included are numerous food & beverages booths along with live music and other entertainment and a kids’ corner.

Festival of Nations
August 23-24, 2025

Three stages of non-stop dynamic music and dance performances by traditional ethnic artists, world music favorites and the finest traditional acoustic music and song. From Spanish flamenco to a Vietnamese lion dance, from thundering drums to Irish harp, there is something for every taste.

Big Muddy Blues Festival
September 6-8, 2025

The Big Muddy Blue Festival provides a platform for a wide range of artists who represent extensions of the Blues genre, such as, soul, R&B, rockabilly, gospel and jazz. Big Muddy is the region’s largest Blues music event features over 18 hours of music and scores of bands on multiple stages throughout the cobblestone streets of Laclede’s Landing, while boasting the Big Muddy (Mississippi River) itself as the iconic river backdrop for the weekend.

MOSAICS, Missouri Festival for the Arts
September 12-14, 2025

Several blocks of North Main Street in Historic St. Charles will play host to more than 75,000 people at the annual MOSAICS Missouri Festival for the Arts. This free arts festival is a family friendly weekend event, with activities for everyone including fantastic art, great entertainment, and the opportunity for children to create their own artwork.

Opening Weekend and Happy Easter

04/03/2026 –04/05/2026

Welcome back to Chestnut Lake as we celebrate opening weekend and Easter! On Saturday, make an Easter craft at 10 a.m., then take pictures with the Easter Bunny at noon. The Easter egg hunt begins at 1 p.m., followed by making a Peep house at 3 p.m. On Sunday morning, stop by for coffee and Danish at 9 a.m.

Welcome Back Weekend

04/10/2026 –04/12/2026

Welcome back to another great camping season at Chestnut Lake! Friday evening begins with Candy Bar Bingo at 6 p.m., followed by an adult dart competition at 9 p.m. On Saturday, create a spring snow globe at 11 a.m., take a nature hike at 1 p.m., and build your own birdhouse at 3 p.m.

Prom Weekend

08/21/2026 –08/23/2026

Celebrate prom season with a fun weekend at the campground! Friday begins at 6 p.m. by making a duct tape corsage, followed by decorating the Rec Hall at 8 p.m. On Saturday, Kids Can Cook - Graduation Celebration starts at 10 a.m., then join a game of kickball at noon. Pass the Prize begins at 2 p.m., followed by crafts at 4 p.m. Get dressed up for prom from 7-10 p.m. in the Rec Hall. On Sunday, join the Chestnut Lake Community Meeting at 10:30 a.m.

Friendsgiving

09/25/2026 –09/27/2026

Celebrate friendship and gratitude during our Friendsgiving weekend! Friday night begins with Family Bingo at 7 p.m. On Saturday, enjoy a Thanksgiving craft at 11 a.m., followed by our community Thanksgiving dinner at 5 p.m. The evening continues with music and fun during the Chestnut Lake DJ party at 6 p.m.

Halloween Weekend #1

10/02/2026 –10/04/2026

Celebrate another spooky Halloween weekend! The fun begins Friday at 6 p.m. with a wagon ride to plant the pumpkin seeds. On Saturday, take a wagon ride to the Pumpkin Patch at noon, then enjoy pumpkin painting at 1:30 p.m. Show off your best costume during the costume contest at 3 p.m., followed by trick-or-treating around the campground at 4 p.m. The evening wraps up with a Halloween party at 6 p.m.

Let's Clean Up Weekend

10/16/2026 –10/18/2026

Join your fellow campers Sunday at 10:30 a.m. for the Chestnut Lake Community Meeting as we gather to discuss the season and help keep our campground looking its best.

04/10/2026 –04/12/2026

Join us for Spring Clean-up this weekend as we kick off the 2026 season with a fresh start and help get the campground ready for an amazing year ahead.

Mom's the Bomb Weekend

05/08/2026 –05/10/2026

Happy Mother's Day! Come out and enjoy some fun mother/child events happening throughout the weekend. While mom relaxes with donuts and coffee, kids can create a special craft just for her.

Luau Weekend

05/15/2026 –05/17/2026

Get ready for a weekend of tropical fun with a traditional luau hosted by our Halloween Committee. It's the perfect opportunity to relax, celebrate, and experience the vibrant spirit of island culture!

Memorial Day and Member Appreciation Weekend

05/22/2026 –05/25/2026

The wait is finally over! Shake off the winter blues and kick off the season with a jump in the pool or a kayak trip around the lake. Enjoy a full weekend of activities including live bands, tie-dye, softball games, a pool party, Family Feud, the Halloween Committee's Basket Auction and Hot Wheels races, and so much more. Don't forget to join us Saturday for our special Member Appreciation event!

Explore the Outdoors with Dad

06/19/2026 –06/21/2026

Come explore the outdoors with us. Join our Halloween Committee fishing tournament, enjoy a father-child tent night and stargazing on the softball field, then top it all off with a Father's Day breakfast on Sunday morning.

Stars, Stripes, & Summer Nights

07/03/2026 –07/05/2026

Our July 4th weekend will be packed with live music by Derek Warner, DJs, a festive golf cart parade, and crowd-favorite events like the Halloween Committee's Hot Wheels race and watermelon eating competition. Plus, enjoy even more activities all weekend long!

Super Soaker Weekend

07/17/2026 –07/19/2026

Join us for a Wet 'n' Wild weekend with the Halloween Committee's annual duck race, a soakin' hayride, and a nighttime pool party. Bring your swimsuits and get ready for a weekend full of water-filled fun!

Santa in the Sun

07/24/2026 –07/26/2026

Get ready for Christmas in July - a summer celebration you won't want to miss! Enjoy a special visit from Santa as he arrives by firetruck, snap photos with the big guy himself, and dive into a weekend packed with festive fun. It's holiday cheer with a sunny twist for the whole family!

Boots & Bandanas

07/31/2026 –08/02/2026

Saddle up for our Wild West weekend featuring the Halloween Committee's annual chicken BBQ and the always popular Sheriff's arrests. Enjoy live music by Derek Warner, pony rides, then wrap up the night with some boot-scootin' line dancing!

Carnival Weekend

08/14/2026 –08/16/2026

Get ready for Carnival weekend hosted by the Halloween Committee, with the campground hosting the traveling RC cars. End the night with a family magician and plenty of fun for all ages!

Viva Las Vegas

08/28/2026 –08/30/2026

Get ready for our debut Viva Las Vegas weekend! From a traveling casino night to live music by the "Dirty Genes Band", the excitement doesn't stop. Add in the Halloween Committee's daytime poker run for adults, and you've got a weekend designed entirely for grown-up fun.

Summer Send-off

09/04/2026 –09/07/2026

Celebrate Labor Day weekend with a daytime pool party, a morning adult softball game, cornhole tournament, and our annual adult chopped event. Enjoy live music by the "99 Reasons Band", plus the Halloween Committee's basket auction and Hot Wheels event, and so much more all weekend long!

Halloween Fright Fest Weekend #1

10/02/2026 –10/04/2026

Kick off spooky season with Halloween Fright Fest weekend #1, featuring festive decorations, themed activities, and frightfully fun entertainment for all ages.

Halloween Fright Fest Weekend #2

10/09/2026 –10/11/2026

The Halloween fun continues with even more spooky activities, costumes, and seasonal excitement during Fright Fest weekend #2.

Halloween Fright Fest Rain Date

10/17/2026 –10/17/2026

This rain date ensures the Halloween Fright Fest fun lives on with rescheduled activities and festive fall excitement.

Public Announcement – Utah Lake State Park Marina Slips (2026 Season)

Utah Lake State Park would like to inform the public that all marina slips for the 2026 boating season have now been fully rented. After working through our waiting list, the remaining slips have been filled due to the continued high demand for slip rentals at the Utah Lake State Park Marina.

To everyone who secured a slip for the 2026 season at Utah Lake State Park, we are excited to welcome you to another great boating season. For our returning slip holders, we sincerely appreciate your continued support and the role you play in making the marina such a strong and enjoyable community each year. For those who are new to the marina this season, we look forward to getting to know you and are excited to have you join the Utah Lake State Park boating communit
The team at Utah Lake State Park looks forward to a safe, fun, and memorable season on the water with all of our 2026 slip holders.
